```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Here, I will perform analysis on the single-cell level.

```{r load-data}
spe <- readRDS("~/Desktop/IMC processing/data_analysis/spe_comp.rds")
```

## Dimensionality reduction

First, I will visualize the cells.

```{r tsne-umap, message=FALSE}
library(scater)
library(uwot)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(22)

spe <- runTSNE(spe, subset_row = rowData(spe)$use_channels,
                        exprs_values = "exprs")

spe <- runUMAP(spe, subset_row = rowData(spe)$use_channels,
                        exprs_values = "exprs")


plotReducedDim(spe, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "indication")
plotReducedDim(spe, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "indication")

```

## Marker expression visualization

Next, I will visualize single-cell marker expression.

```{r viz markers, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
#Visualize marker of interest
plotReducedDim(spe, dimred = "UMAP", 
               colour_by = "CD20", 
               shape_by = "indication",
               by_exprs_values = "exprs",
               point_size = 0.5)
?plotReducedDim

#Visualize all markers at once
library(cowplot)
all_plots <- lapply(c(rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(spe, dimred = "UMAP", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)
                      return(p)                    
                    })

plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots)
```

## Clustering

Here I will use Rphenograph to cluster the cells.

```{r clustering}
library(Rphenograph)
library(RColorBrewer)

set.seed(22)
out <- Rphenograph(t(assay(spe, "exprs")[rowData(spe)$use_channel,]),
                   k = 100)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

dim(assay(spe))

spe$clusters <- clusters


cluster_color <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"Set1"))(length(unique(clusters)))
names(cluster_color) <- levels(clusters)

plotReducedDim(spe, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "clusters") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_color)

```
##Postive or negative for certain markers

```{r number-pos, message = F,fig.width=15,fig.height=10}

library(mclust)
library(dittoSeq)
library(viridis)
library(scuttle)

# CD45RO 
cur_clust <- Mclust(assay(spe, "exprs")["CD45RO",], G = 2)

plot(cur_clust, what = "classification")
plot(cur_clust, what = "density")

spe$CD45_class <- cur_clust$classification
  
  colData(spe) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(classification = as.factor(cur_clust$classification)) %>%
  group_by(indication, classification, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarize(n_cells = n()) %>%
  mutate(fraction_cells = n_cells/sum(n_cells)) %>%
  ggplot() + geom_tile(aes(classification,indication, fill = fraction_cells)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                                                 hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Fraction of CD45RO+ cells")
  
  
### Subset SPE accordingly
  
spe_CD45 <- spe[,spe$CD45_class == "2"]

#Re-run dimensionality reduction 
spe_CD45 <- runUMAP(spe_CD45, subset_row = rowData(spe_CD45)$use_channels,
                        exprs_values = "exprs")
spe_CD45 <- runTSNE(spe_CD45, subset_row = rowData(spe_CD45)$use_channels,
                        exprs_values = "exprs")

plotReducedDim(spe_CD45, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "indication")

#Re-run clustering
set.seed(22)
out <- Rphenograph(t(assay(spe_CD45, "exprs")[rowData(spe_CD45)$use_channel,]),
                   k = 100)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

spe_CD45$clusters <- clusters

cluster_color <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"Paired"))(length(unique(clusters)))
names(cluster_color) <- levels(clusters)

plotReducedDim(spe_CD45, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "clusters") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_color)

#Heatmap visualization
dittoHeatmap(spe_CD45, genes = rownames(spe_CD45)[rowData(spe)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = F, order.by = "clusters" , scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), annot.by = c("clusters","indication"))

```

##Cluster annotation based on marker expression

```{r anno-cluster, message = F,fig.width=15,fig.height=10}

#1. based on asinh-transformed expression counts

#Genes of interest
plotExpression(spe, exprs_values = "min_max",features=c("CD45RA", "CD45RO", "CD3", "CD4","CD8a","CD20"),
    x=I(clusters), colour_by=I(clusters))

ids = spe$clusters
#ids = DataFrame(spe$clusters,spe$sample_id)
#ids = spe$sample_id


#AggregateAcrossCells does not work for SPE? 
#try using SCE from the start - try again tomorrow - talk to Nils about gating strategy

mean_spe <- aggregateAcrossCells(spe, ids = spe$clusters,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(spe)$use_channel)


?I()

unique(names(ids))
example_SPE =mockSPE()


plotHeatmap(mean_spe, features = rownames(mean_spe), columns = mean_spe$indication,
            exprs_values = "exprs", center = TRUE, scale = TRUE, 
            colour_columns_by = mean_spe$sample_id)
            
dittoHeatmap(mean_spe, genes = rownames(mean_spe), assay = "exprs", metas = "indication")

colData(mean_spe)

column_annotation_colors = list(clusters = cluster_color))




#Min-Max normalization (min = 0, max = 1)
assay(spe, "min_max") <- assay(spe, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(spe, "exprs"))
assay(spe, "min_max") <- assay(spe, "min_max") / rowQuantiles(assay(spe, "exprs"), probs = 0.99)

plotExpression(spe, exprs_values = "min_max",features=c("CD45RA", "CD45RO", "CD3", "CD4","CD8a","CD20"),
    x=I(clusters), colour_by=I(clusters))


```
